integrity: Exact rational/quadratic field finite comparisons and independent symbolic Legendre kernel reconstruction; infinite positivity separately follows from stated classical Bernstein inequality. No independent mathematical audit or publication-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem applies only to evaluation of a single homogeneous spherical-harmonic degree on the 10 antipodal vertex lines of a regular dodecahedron. title: Complete degree-wise harmonic interpolation on the ten dodecahedral axes
